about_the_game:
Create you defense

Select a commander, upgrades and towers to fit your strategy. Build your defenses to stop the endless waves of demons, beasts and undead. Select towers to build, each tower is unique and can give bonuses to nearby towers, so place them wisely. Unlock new commanders, upgrades, towers and maps. Try to survive as long as possible!

Features

  • Tower defense

    • Build your defense from by choosing from a wide range of unique towers.

  • Strategy

    • All towers are unique. They vary in attack behavior, many have special passives and abilities and can give various bonuses to nearby towers. During a game you can also upgrade your towers.

  • Dynamic enemy pathfinding

    • Enemies have dynamic pathfinding, so there is no fixed path they take to their goal. Use this to your advantage!

  • Roguelike elements

    • Choose a strategy and survive as long as possible!

  • Unlocks

    • By playing you can unlock new commanders, traits, towers and maps.

  • Multiple maps

    • There are multiple playable maps, each with a unique look and layout and enemies.

  • Endless mode

    • Each map has a final boss. But you can choose to keep playing after defeating this boss to continue in an "endless" mode where new waves will spawn to test how far you can really go!

Credits:

Trailer music: saurabh-chaudhary

short_description: A roguelike tower defense with high level of strategy and tactics. Build towers to maximize bonuses and synergies to stop the endless horde of demons, beasts and undead. Unlock new commanders and upgrades, employ endless strategies to reach as far as you can.
